meta.title: A PR line on hold slips into a draft that has no stage yet, and loses its hold
gaps: No setup recipe creates a QA PR line on hold with open quantity or a draft containing lines with no stage.
No operation or library case expresses pulling a held PR line into a draft.
The is_pr_hold_enabled gate cannot be set or asserted.
The PR line status cannot be read with the available operations or read-back fields.
